entries.rationale: Cargo resolves transitive version coexistence; source code cannot eliminate every duplicate version.
entries.safety_invariant: Direct dependency routes, checksums, licenses, advisories, and duplicate versions remain governed by dependency policy.
entries.alternatives_considered: Enabling the lint creates unactionable failures for transitive resolution outside the crate's control.
entries.substitute: cargo deny, dependency-unsafe graph policy, and locked dependency review
entries.evidence: Cargo.lock plus reviewed dependency graph baselines

entries.rationale: The compiler's unreachable_pub lint is the canonical visibility check and conflicts with this Clippy opinion.
entries.safety_invariant: Unreachable public surface remains warned by rustc and restricted internal surface remains separately ratcheted.
entries.alternatives_considered: Running both produces conflicting advice without increasing visibility coverage.
entries.substitute: rustc unreachable_pub plus the restricted-visibility maintainability rail
entries.sentinel: just clippy and visibility policy checks
entries.evidence: Cargo lint configuration and visibility inventory

entries.rationale: The checked-in fixture must permit its test-only unwrap so the production profile sentinel can prove the command-line deny wins only in shipped targets.
entries.safety_invariant: The allowance is confined to the isolated fixture manifest and production fixture lanes still deny unwrap_used.
entries.alternatives_considered: Removing it would make the fixture unable to distinguish ordinary test policy from the production override.
entries.substitute: production-clippy command-line deny with positive and negative fixture sentinels
entries.re_review_phase: Whenever the production Clippy matrix changes
